title: console first load: the Studio en strings and metadata-form i18n are still in the eager closure (split from #33293)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: split card of #33293 (p3), per its order's split clause; the edges were measured by PR #33580 (os-dev-report 6887255208, PR body "Acceptance notes" → "Why this PR stops here"). Reader: `domain:ui`. Grade p3, the parent's grade, self-graded by the lane seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open i18n-ns-studio eager` finds only the parent #33293.

## What the user sees

Every Console route still downloads the Studio `en` string namespace (`i18n-ns-studio-en`, 64.3 KB gzipped) and `metadata-form-i18n` before it asks for data, though only Studio and Setup pages draw them.

## Where (edges read from the module graph of the #33580 build `30cbab20`)

`namespaces/studio/index.ts` imports `en.ts` statically by design (the synchronous `en` fallback, objectstack#25922), and `index.ts` is eager twice over:
- the `i18n-runtime` manual chunk group (`/packages/i18n/`) captures it into an eager chunk;
- four eager modules import app-shell's `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: `studio-design/studio-canvas-preview.tsx` (bare-imported by the package entry for its load-time `registerStudioCanvasPreview('object', …)`), `metadata-admin/datasource/register.ts` (`DatasourceResourcePage` by value), `PositionGrantCells` (by value, from `builtinComponents.tsx`), and `CreateViewDialog` → `objectDatasets` → `useDatasetCatalog`.
- Two small stragglers ride the same edges: `object-fields-io` (via `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`) and `json-schema-to-fields` (via `DatasourceResourcePage`).

## Acceptance

- The default canvas preview in `studio-canvas-preview.tsx` moves to a module of its own and is registered lazily (a file split of about 400 lines in a `sideEffects`-array module).
- `DatasourceResourcePage` and the two position cells are registered lazily (the `lazyPage` shape #33580 added in `builtinComponents.tsx`); `CreateViewDialog` is lazy in `ObjectView`.
- An `i18n-ns-studio` group in `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`, like `i18n-ns-marketplace`. The synchronous `en` fallback stays.
- Measured from `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` on two builds: `i18n-ns-studio-en` and `metadata-form-i18n` leave the closure; Studio and Setup draw as before, `en` strings included, in a built console in a real browser.

Refs #33293
